scope: Country-year aggregates, 1930–2026. Regions and non-ISO entities omitted.

indicators.name: Homicide rate
indicators.source: UNODC via Our World in Data
indicators.citation: Intentional homicides per 100,000 people. UNODC criminal-justice and public-health records, via Our World in Data. UK is combined by OWID from England, Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland.

indicators.name: Daily calorie supply
indicators.source: FAO via Our World in Data
indicators.citation: Kilocalories available per person per day (food supply, not measured intake). FAO Food Balance Sheets via Our World in Data. Pre-1961 points are historical reconstructions and are estimates.

indicators.name: Deaths in armed conflicts
indicators.source: UCDP via Our World in Data
indicators.citation: Best estimate of combatant and civilian deaths from fighting, located by where they occurred. Uppsala Conflict Data Program via Our World in Data. Explicit zeros mean no recorded battle deaths. 2026 is preliminary and covers a partial year.

indicators.name: GDP per capita
indicators.source: World Bank via Our World in Data
indicators.citation: GDP per capita, PPP, in constant 2021 international dollars. World Bank via Our World in Data. Adjusted for inflation and price differences between countries.

indicators.name: Alcohol consumption
indicators.source: WHO via World Bank and Our World in Data
indicators.citation: Liters of pure alcohol per person aged 15 or older, per year. WHO Global Health Observatory via the World Bank, processed by Our World in Data. Includes recorded and estimated unrecorded consumption.

indicators.name: Temperature anomaly
indicators.source: Copernicus via Our World in Data
indicators.citation: Annual mean surface temperature minus that country's 1991–2020 mean, in °C. Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information, with major processing by Our World in Data. Small landmasses are less reliable.
